cohort: 104 pregnant women who underwent abdominopelvic CT for any medical indication and had either normal vaginal deliveries or cesarean deliveries due to CPD
finding: The mid-pelvis CPCI, representing the ratio between fetal head circumference and maternal pelvic circumference, was significantly associated with cesarean delivery due to CPD, suggesting its potential as a predictor for CPD risk during labor.
mod_finding: A higher cephalopelvic circumference index (ratio of head circumference to pelvic circumference) was independently associated with cesarean delivery due to cephalopelvic disproportion.
